shadows.name: content-panel
shadows.purpose: Separate light content panels from the dark canvas.

shadows.name: feature-card
shadows.purpose: Structural depth for large feature cards.

motion.name: state-transition

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action with a clear navy-to-gold hover state.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #16213E; border-radius: 6px; background: #16213E; color: #F8F5F2; font: 500 1rem Poppins, sans-serif; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: #E6C72A; background: #E6C72A; color: #16213E; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E6C72A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Quiet, readable form control for light content surfaces.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #16213E; font: 400 .875rem Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(22, 33, 62, .24); border-radius: 6px; background: #F8F5F2; color: #16213E; font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E6C72A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Compact link with a clear active and focus state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; color: #F8F5F2; font: 500 1rem Poppins, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { background: #E6C72A; color: #16213E; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F8F5F2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Ivory content surface for a featured event or information block.
components.css: .ds-feature-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 199, 42, .6); border-radius: 16px; background: #F8F5F2; color: #16213E; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .25); } .ds-feature-card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #16213E; font: 400 1.5rem 'Playfair Display', serif; } .ds-feature-card p { margin: 0; color: #6C677D; font: 400 1rem Poppins, sans-serif; }

components.name: Celestial Accent
components.description: Decorative gold orbit detail; hide from assistive technology when non-informative.
components.css: .ds-celestial-accent { display: block; width: 56px; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #E6C72A, #D97706); }

narrative.overview: IPFEST 2027 pairs a cinematic night-sky atmosphere with a refined editorial voice. Midnight navy and the supplied wave background establish depth; orbit lines, nodes, and star-like accents suggest energy, connection, and exploration. Warm ivory protects readability, while muted gold and burnt orange act as controlled light sources rather than broad decorative fills. The identity should feel cinematic and refined, with layered, luminous surfaces and confident, polished controls.
keyCharacteristics: Celestial motion expressed through orbit lines and nodes.
Confident Plus Jakarta Sans headings balanced by a legible Poppins body face.
Navy-first surfaces, warm ivory content panels, restrained gold/orange accents.
Real IPFEST identity assets take precedence over recreated marks.

rules.name: The Light-Source Rule
rules.body: Gold and orange should read as light and emphasis; do not let them replace navy or ivory as the dominant surface colors.

rules.name: The One-Luminous-Layer Rule
rules.body: Within a component, use one clear elevation cue—tonal separation, border, or shadow—before stacking effects.

dos: Do use the exact palette and the supplied Grand Design Board as the visual authority.
Do source official logos, mascot, background, and decorative elements from public/static/images/ rather than redrawing them.
Do pair expressive display typography with Poppins for readable interface copy.
Do use ipfest-background.jpg as the sole page background; use content surfaces for contrast without adding a background wash.
Do keep section headings concise (for example, 'Pilih Kompetisi', 'Ketua Tim', and 'Pembuatan Akun') and place explanations in supporting copy.
Do ensure local font URLs match the supplied filenames.
donts: Don't use Dream Avenue, Safira March, or Great Vibes as default headings or body faces; reserve them for occasional accents.
Don't stretch, recolor, crop tightly, or add effects to official logo assets.
Don't use orbit lines, nodes, mascot, or gold accents as wallpaper behind dense text.
Don't use Great Vibes for long text, labels, or controls.
Don't add generic purple gradients, dotted-halftone overlays, or unrelated decorative patterns to this identity.
